name: KGMeasure
title: Knowledge graph L3: Measure
description: A FHIR Measure -- an indicator made computable. 41 in the immunizations IG, all declaring proportion-measure-cqfm; the SOP makes the profile depend on scoring type, which is why the profile is read rather than assumed. Joined to its L2 indicator by id convention (IMMZ.IND.08 -> IMMZIND08). Class IRI: http://smart.who.int/kg/measure.

element.definition: A FHIR Measure -- an indicator made computable. 41 in the immunizations IG, all declaring proportion-measure-cqfm; the SOP makes the profile depend on scoring type, which is why the profile is read rather than assumed. Joined to its L2 indicator by id convention (IMMZ.IND.08 -> IMMZIND08). Class IRI: http://smart.who.int/kg/measure.
The canonical URL. Only a resolved component carries one.
The FHIR resource type.
A profile canonical the artefact declares (meta.profile or the requirement's profile).
The resource's status (FHIR PublicationStatus).
The business version, as declared.
The human-readable title.
The computable name: the CamelCase identifier a Canonical() reference matches on.
The publisher, as declared.
The resource's experimental flag.
The Measure's scoring (proportion, ratio, cohort, continuous-variable).
Where the node was read from: a repository path or URL.
Hash of the file the node was read from; pins the source.
